meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装好后，当你要做 Git 提交或查历史时，Claude 会先判断请求类型，再把改动拆成相互独立的小提交，或查证后给出附证据的答案；它只动你要求的改动，并保留无关内容。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Git 提交、改写历史，或询问某段代码是谁/何时改的时触发；普通代码编辑除非点名要 Git 操作否则不触发。

say.text: 把这几个文件的改动提交成两个独立的 commit
say.note: Claude 会按原子提交规则拆分并提交。

say.text: 第 50 到 60 行是谁改的？
把最近三个提交合并成一个
say.note: Claude 会执行 rebase 并注意是否已推送。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask for a Git commit or history investigation, Claude first classifies the request, then splits changes into independent small commits or answers with evidence-based findings; it touches only what you asked and preserves unrelated work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a Git commit, history rewrite, or who/when changed something; not for ordinary code edits unless Git work is requested.

say_en.text: Commit these file changes as two separate commits.
say_en.note: Claude will split and commit atomically.
Claude will run git blame and show hash and context.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude will rebase and check if they were pushed.
